title: Remove a package with aptitude
summary: Uninstalls a specified software package and any packages that depend on it. This cleans up your system by removing unused software.

steps.explain: Removes the specified package and all packages depending on it.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE
placeholders.description: The name of the package to remove

rollback.explain: Re-install the package if you need to undo the removal.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE
placeholders.description: The name of the package to re-install

warnings: Removing packages may remove other software that depends on them.
